QuestInfo.name: A Third Gift for the Dragon Master
QuestInfo.0: When you reach Lv. 55, #p9010010# starts talking to you...
QuestInfo.1: #p9010010# congratulates you for reaching Lv. 55 and tells you that she will give you another scroll when you are ready. Just how many scrolls has #p9010010# prepared? In any case, go to town and meet #p9010010# when you reach Lv. 60.
QuestInfo.2: You received a scroll from #p9010010#. She says that she will give you an even better scroll if you reach Lv. 70 by #bMay 4#k.

0.0: Wow, Evan! You're Level 55 already? You really are fast... This is all so that you can get my gifts right? Hehehe, I guess everyone needs a little motivation. When you reach Level 60, come #bfind me in town#k so that I can give you the scroll.

no.0: Hmm. Why are you acting like you weren't expecting the scroll? Now, now, I can see through that. I know exactly what you're thinking, so no need to pretend to refuse.

1.0: I'm glad you're here, Evan. Let's just cut to the chase. Here is the scroll that you so desired!

yes.0: You probably expected this...but this is not the end of the scrolls! I will give you the next scroll if you can reach #bLevel 70 by May 4th#k. The next scroll will be better than the previous ones! See you next time, Evan.

default.0: Your Level is still a bit low. When you reach Level 60, you can receive a special gift that will only be given out during the event period. The event ends on May 4th, so be sure to hurry.
